summary: Specifies several basic forward error correction schemes for the Reliable Multicast Transport building block, including the compact no-code, small block, large block, expandable, and small block systematic schemes. This is a Proposed Standard that obsoletes RFC 3452 and RFC 3695.

eli5.summary: Send extra repair pieces along with the data, so if some pieces get lost the receiver can fill the gaps without asking again. This memo lists simple ways to do that.

questions: forward error correction for reliable multicast
